$comment: Glossary for L-13 (doc 06 §3.7, §4.3; doc 08 §7.2; R64). Sources: doc 08 §7.2.1 tables T-A–T-E (es column, checked against WordByWordPrototype/Localizable.xcstrings), §7.2.2 rules ①–③ (no X-fix lists es), §7.3 es row (tú; 'desliza (a la derecha)', 'toca dos veces'), the es copy deck (src/locales/es.json, M3, T2).

required: key path → value used verbatim. Kickers use the app's names without the '(Significado AI)' suffix (as en / ja / zh-Hans do); es has no short name for the swipe feature (T-A '—'), so the kicker is the feature name 'Deslizar para traducir'. Quota-table rows are the app's names (daily_sentence_translation_limit + engine, word_meaning_lookup_title, more_definitions_title, Chunk Extraction, sentence_skeleton_ui_analyze), shortened so that each row fits two lines in the 390 px table ('· nube' / '· local', '(IA)' for '(Significado AI)'); the website writes 'IA' outside quoted app labels (the app mixes 'AI' and 'IA' in es — reported to the owner in docs/redesign-2026/ops/m3/es-qa.md, not an X-fix yet).

contains: in-app button / setting names that the sentence quotes verbatim in “ ” (rule ①; T-B get_syntax_explanation_button, T-C audio_playback_title_*, T-E upgrade_now_button / restore_purchase_button).
banned: variants that must not appear in any leaf value (pattern = literal text unless regex:true; flags 'i' = case-insensitive).

features[syntax].text: Obtener explicación de sintaxis de IA

banned.note: the gesture is a right swipe; a left swipe removes the translation (F14)
touch gesture, not a mouse double-click (doc 08 §7.2.2 X7 by analogy)
lookup is a double tap, never a single tap (doc 08 §1.1 lookup row)
